reviews.title: Planos
reviews.body:
Solicitei há dois dias, por e-mail, uma explicação detalhada sobre os valores e as diferenças entre os planos anuais do aplicativo GlipOne. Pelo que entendi, existem três opções de planos, porém não encontrei em nenhum lugar uma descrição clara do que cada plano oferece ao cliente.

Como estou avaliando o aplicativo antes de tomar uma decisão, essas informações são muito importantes para mim. Poderiam, por gentileza, me enviar a explicação completa das opções disponíveis em cada plano?

Agradeço desde já pela atenção e fico no aguardo do retorno.

reviews.title: It’s ok
reviews.body: Bought the $50 lifetime but kinda wish I hadn’t. Food tracking leaves a lot to be desired. I use a different app that pulls into my Apple Health app but Mingo doesn’t pull the nutrition from it so I have to log twice. Also, I thought the “mascot” of the app would be interactive on daily progress but it’s just trackers and normal reminders. The dashboards and shot logs are great.

reviews.title: Game changer for tracking food and staying consistent
reviews.body:
Not gonna lie, I’ve downloaded sooo many food tracking apps and never stick to any of them… but this one?? actually 10/10.

Being able to just snap a pic of my food and instantly see calories + protein is kinda crazy. Like it takes 2 seconds and I don’t have to guess anything. It makes tracking feel way less annoying, also the reminders are clutch on busy days when I’d normally forget.
If you’re like me and can never stay consistent 😂, this app just makes it easy. Definitely one of the best apps I’ve downloaded this year. 10/10 fr.

reviews.title: Great app for losing weight!
reviews.body: I have used Lose it off and on throughout the years. It helps you realize exactly how much you are eating and burning. My advice is to enter it before eating, that way, you may make some adjustments before it is too late and you have blown your daily budget. The good news is, on a bad budget day, just put on your walking shoes and walk until that little red line disappears. I love the reminders to fast and stop fasting. It really is a life style change that will help you lose if you are dedicated and stick with the plan!!

reviews.title: Very user friendly

I love that it hooks up to my Apple Watch, to track my actual activity level for the day., Instead of just counting when I have a workout. Been using it for over two years and I can realistically say that if you track your calories accurately, it’s super easy to control your weight (having a small kitchen scale to quickly measure grams is super helpful). I lost almost 40 lbs and have been able to keep my weight stable for over a year.

reviews.title: Sugestão de melhoria
reviews.body:
Utilizo o APP faz um bom tempo e acho ele muito bom, porém na minha dieta e creio que na dieta da maioria das pessoas constam mais de 4 refeições, por exemplo:

1 - Café da manhã
2 - Lanche 1
3 - Almoço
4 - Lanche 2
5 - Jantar
6 - Ceia

Porém no app consta apenas 4 refeições e isso é fixo, fazendo que eu não consiga distribuir de maneira satisfatória a minha dieta.

A minha dica de melhoria para o APP seria a possibilidade de criar novas refeições, isso deixa o app mais flexível e mais adaptável às diversas dietas do público.

Espero que levem em consideração um novo release com esta funcional

reviews.title: Great tool
reviews.body: The most common nutrition information is included in the app, but it could stand an update with the latest about artificial sweeteners being bad and causing cravings, and to include healthier fruits and veggies as well as the protein. Salt intake also may be an issue, and there should be options to include different kinds of salts other than table salt. Perhaps supplementation should be included, so you can stack vitamins and minerals, with herbal remedies would be good, so users can track what is most beneficial for them in the app. Each person is different, so these small changes would help.

reviews.title: Helpful
reviews.body: The Balance App is a great women’s health centered app. It includes a lot of information about female hormones changes, but also data about women’s experiences with BHRT. There’s is lifestyle supoort as well. I could not be without the symptoms teacker or period log- they make me feel every day like what I am going through is normal and there is a hopeful future ahead still. I would suggest this App for women at any age going through hormone changes and who even just want to learn about it.

reviews.body:
First off really good symptom tracker.  But would make it better is allowing us to track what hrt doses we are on for the day. Part of helping to fix issues is to learn which symptoms are meaning low hormones or levels and which symptoms are meaning higher ones. A tracking area for labs would be great too.  

Also would be wonderful for hrt method tracking to allow usa users to input their own Brand of hrt. 

Women all over are waiting for an app to cover all those basis to help them learn what means what with their body and connecting the dots can be really difficult as high and or low sympto

reviews.title: Menopause
reviews.body: I’ve been perimenopausal for years. My gynecologist even prescribed Prozac for my anxiety but never treated my symptoms. After listening to a podcast with Liz Earl and dr Louise I realized my periods stopped for at least 7 months maybe longer and I have most of the symptoms in your questionnaire. Looking for a doctor to start HRT. Thank god in Brazil, where I live, doctors prescribe the hormones!!! Can’t wait to feel the changes!!!

reviews.title: O app tem tudo pra ser bom

Já abri chamado, indiquei bugs, conversei com a equipe sugerindo melhorias e nada. Daria nota média pelo número de bugs mas seria passar a mensagem errada considerando que deram as costas para as evoluções.

Por favor, implementem um formulário simples, ou pelo menos deem a opção, para os usuários que não quiserem essa "experiência". Quase desisti umas três vezes. Vou dar uma chance para o app por alguns dias porque tive boas referências, mas espero ver a "Jéssica" pouquíssimas vezes. Esse tipo de ferramenta é útil para substituir algum tipo de formulário de contato, funcionalidade que o app não tem (pelo menos não encontrei com facilidade).

Adquiri uma assinatura do aplicativo por intermédio da App Store .Diante da insatisfação com o serviço, solicitei o cancelamento dentro do prazo legal de 7 (sete) dias assegurado pelo artigo 49 do Código de Defesa do Consumidor (CDC), referente a compras realizadas fora do estabelecimento comercial (compras digitais/online).

Ocorre que tentei realizar o procedimento de cancelamento e estorno pelos canais disponibilizados, mas não obtive o suporte adequado nem a garantia do meu direito de cancelamento imediato e reembolso, gerando cobranças indevidas e abusivas. Vale ressaltar que a responsabi

reviews.title: 4 kg a menos em menos de 3 meses!
reviews.body:
O Foodvisor tem sido uma ótima ferramenta para acompanhar minha alimentação e manter o controle das calorias diárias. O aplicativo facilita bastante a organização das refeições e ajuda a manter o foco nas metas.

Em menos de três meses, eliminei 4 kg, conciliando uma alimentação mais equilibrada com treinos regulares.

É claro que o aplicativo não faz o trabalho sozinho, mas ajuda muito a transformar disciplina e constância em resultados. Recomendo!

reviews.title: Funciona de verdade
reviews.body: Foodvisor has taught me a lot about my diet. I’ve been able to change my habits; I realized I was eating much more than I actually needed, and I’m learning a lot about nutrition and food quality. After using it for months, even though I don’t track everything I eat with the app, I’m able to make much better, more mindful choices and stay in control of my weight. My quality of life has improved a lot!

Noom was extremely helpful as an entry point to healthy eating. I paid for it for two years and used the free version for a third year. It helped me lose 25 pounds while understanding nutrition and the psychology of eating.

Noom’s limitation is the time it takes to log your food appropriately. I eventually ran out of the energy to keep it up daily. I also found that other trackers use macros more efficiently and save the item-by-item logging. That being said, macros only work if you know what is in your food, so I would still recommend Noom’s approach for a beginner.

La verdad yo ocupo una motivación más grande, y no puedo estar pegada en el teléfono tomando cursillos que poco me ayudan. Por lo que cuesta, mejor invierto en una mensualidad del gym o nutrióloga, tema resuelto.

reviews.title: Alimentación consciente
reviews.body:
Más que un programa de alimentación o dieta, Noom te va guiando para cambiar elecciones y mejorar tu estilo de vida. Usan el método de alimentación consciente y a mi me ha servido mucho. 

Para los que comentan del precio excesivo, después del periodo de prueba, cuesta $150 usd por 3 meses. Eso es +- 3,000 mnx, es decir $250 pesos a la semana. Mucho menos de lo que pagarías con un nutriólogo y además del contenido y funcionalidad de la app, tienes el acompañamiento de un coach que te va guiando y resolviendo dudas. 

La verdad para mi si valió la pena la inversión.

reviews.title: Good price but mostly no fiber tracking
reviews.body:
Can’t beat the price compared to WeightWatchers! Has enough branded foods to be comparable to WW as well. 

A minus for people on GLP-1s: you have to eat plenty of fiber to avoid nasty GI side effects when on a GLP-1. 

As far as I can tell, Healthi only lists fiber in the macros if you use the plan for people subscribed to Healthi’s GLP-1 program, which I am not. 

I am on Carb Conscious, which they claim has fiber as the”the magic ingredient,” but you have to manually add up fiber on your own/off app to keep track. 

Makes this app much less useful than WW, which does track and add up fiber

reviews.title: Some UX improvements would make this better
reviews.body:
This is an over designed app and would benefit from looking at the LoseIt app to improve its usability. Key challenges: if I am eating basically the same breakfast every day, I shouldn’t have to re-enter the individual items and their specific quantities every time. I eat 2 eggs every day, why doesn’t it just save 2 eggs as a suggestion for me to quick add. It just shows all recent foods but with the “base” quantity, so I get suggestions like a glass of wine when I’m just trying to fill out my breakfast. 

This app also really struggles with visual hierarchy and it makes it challenging to read

I had my doubts at first, because of how much Flo had traumatized me, but it literally sends me these funny/scarily relatable messages, and it’s super accurate! I never have to worry about when my period is gonna be, because Stardust has my back.

reviews.body:

reviews.title: Finally!! Answered prayer
reviews.body: My name is Robin and Being 38, and going through premature menopause, I gave up hope in finding something that would help me. This app embodies everything I’ve been looking for and what helps even more  is the community of women who encourage each other. I finally feel like I  found an app that relates to what I’m feeling and finally being understood. I just need to find the right supplements and diet to help with staying healthy during this time. It’s been scary and uncomfortable. But Caria has been an answered prayer of mine. Thank you sooo much

reviews.title: Flo with Menopausal Focus

reviews.body: I loveee how there are places where I can chat with an expert, and even share my own experiences in my menopause journey. I’m also loving how there are programs I can take to help with improving fitness, or getting better sleep at night! Great and amazingly helpful app!

For example, I had allergy testing yesterday which is definitely affecting some of my symptoms. I got a terrible night of sleep a few nights ago, and that affected my energy/fatigue/headache. Just an open text are to enter notes would be super helpful. Thanks!!!!

reviews.body: I like the artwork a lot! Beautiful! And tracking the symptoms that are available here is great. Unfortunately there doesn’t seem to be a way to track headaches (or other unique symptoms) so I’ll keep looking for a different menopause app.

reviews.title: Almost everything I need!
reviews.body: I just loaded and set up this app, I’ve continued to use my period tracker for an entire year since I stopped having periods and decided it was time to get an appropriate tracker for menopause. It seems easy to use and has great info.  I’m curious why there isn’t a spot to track my sexual activity, if having sex is so important to maintaining a healthy vagina. A sex tracker with the ability to comment and save notes on the activity that day would be useful I think.

reviews.title: I Feel Understood and Helped
reviews.body: This app is perfect for any woman going through hormonal, emotional, physical changes and doesn’t want to talk about it 24/7 with everyone she comes in contact with. Sure it’s great when a friend listens and offers some advice. What I like most about the app is that it lets me express my symptoms and gives me guides and meditations that can help while I’m on my lunch break, waiting in line, or right before falling asleep. I highly recommend Clio as tool for change-of-life relief.

reviews.title: Wisdom & motivation, wrapped in a warm hug

I’m looking forward to continuing to use this app... I’m so glad that it exists!

reviews.title: App muito útil mas faltam recursos
reviews.body:
- Poderia ter integração com Apple Health. 
- Não há como ver a tela de evolução de dias passados.
- O cálculo de calorias por IA é bastante impreciso e instável. Você insere os dados de uma refeição e manda calcular as calorias, ele mostra um resultado. Se fechar e mandar calcular de novo, mostra outro. E a diferença é enorme (sem mudar nada na descrição da recepção). Já cheguei a ver diferença de 200kcal. Sugestão: Usar IA apenas para identificar cada alimento. Depois disso, aí é buscar numa tabela fixa de nutrientes/calorias para trazer dados precisos.

Para fazer o registro de refeições com fotos a partir da galeria, na visualização aparece o dia e horário da foto, mas não traz essas informações para o aplicativo e é preciso trocar de forma manual, desestimulando o uso.
A migração foi feita pelo nutricionista, o que me forçou a utilizar este app em detrimento do anterior, mas a navegação é complexa e no diário alimentar não há uma forma de visualizar as refeições feitas em cada dia, é apenas do mês.

reviews.title: So easy!
reviews.body: I love how easy it is to track my meals and how the feedback keeps me motivated!

reviews.title: Love the new focus!
reviews.body: Instead of calorie counting, you can actually end up eating MORE food with the science-based research. Both quantity and quality are important. The new focus on diversity of plant foods and ferments makes it feel much easier and achievable than when the focus was on each food’s score. Their attitude is that the healthy foods can crowd out the less healthy foods, giving you more for your gut to work with. In the process you end up feeling fuller and healthier. The short videos are clips from their podcast explaining the science and how gut health relates to brain and also heart health.

reviews.title: ZOE needs better food matching for whole foods
reviews.body:
In my experience, ZOE works better if you eat a lot of packaged foods. When I scan or search for food, packaged and processed versions seem to come up first, while plain, whole foods are harder to find.

For example, searching for oatmeal brings up packaged oatmeal rather than the plain oats I buy in bulk. A whole avocado comes up correctly, but a sliced avocado brings up a packaged version. It's a strange distinction for the same food.

I eat a lot of natural, whole foods, including food straight from the garden, and this makes logging unnecessarily difficult. The stats may be useful for pack

1. The new program/gut health testing continues to be unavailable in the US, so overall scores can’t show progress. 

2.  The conversion of old gut health scores t due to the discovery of new gut bacteria, viruses and microphages is extraordinarily disappointing. Old scores of 95+ % on a whole food plant based diet with little to no UPFs using then-available data and testing methodologies now show up as as a mediocre 696/1000. Seriously?

reviews.title: Changed my life
reviews.body: This app is changing how I think about food and how what I eat affects my body, one meal, one snack at a time. I am slowly reworking decades of unhealthy food choices through feedback the app provides after every meal I eat. No weighing or measuring of my food. No tracking of macros or obsessing about getting in more protein. I simply take a photo or describe what I have eaten. The app estimates the nutritional content, tells me how the food benefits my body or could have long term health consequences. No scare tactics, no shaming. Simple education and feedback, with suggestions on minor chang

reviews.title: Better than nothing; but there’s so much better out there
reviews.body:
AI ruins the accuracy. The ability to edit for AI mistakes is impossible. I am 16 emails deep and have barely gotten out of the AI unhelpful “please see our FAQs” responses just to change ONE inaccurate food. I’ve only been using the app for a few days but I’ve found 7 plants that don’t register as plants in your weekly count and I can’t change them. 

The food “scores” are arbitrary and opaque. The same food can have a variation of a score of 40 to 90 with no explanation.

The recommended “substitutions” are flawed and inaccurate. One time it told me to substitute the wet version of a pasta f

reviews.title: Some good, mostly bsd
reviews.body: The app has a lot of inaccuracies. For example, it will scan a single serving meal as 5000 calories instead of 400. This has happened multiple times. I tried contacting support, they kept giving me the runaround, asking me to send multiple barcodes and examples when all they have to do is take the product information and investigate themselves. Lazy, inaccurate, not worth the money.

reviews.title: Love it

reviews.title: Goodbye After 3 Years

If you are just starting your health journey, and are going to use the company’s testing to determine health markers such as gut microbiome and blood sugar reactivity, then I would still recommend this app. 

I did that three years ago, and have religiously used this app since then. 

Unfortunately, the new update that happened in July completely changed the structure of the app. All of the features that I was using as a dedicated member are now gone. I cannot upload my own recipes and modify them with ingredients that work for me. I can no longer track my fasting window or the percentage of m

It’s super annoying. And today another thing started happening. When I try to edit a food. And I am able to type something and either won’t type or when I click on a food everything. reviews.title: Zoe Founders—Please READ reviews since APP updates
reviews.body:
Loved previous “classic” Zoe App. New updates, including a gamified jumping bean, a cumbersome and frustrating. While grocery shopping, scanning product barcodes and make informed choices based on my gut test results used to be easy. Simple swaps.  No longer without adding to daily log.  The original app recipe creation was amazing. 

Please read reviews since app updates. I’m not the only dedicated Zoe follower that’s extremely frustrated.
